gate_decisions.evidence_refs: Nonempty evidence refs required for either SATISFIED_BY_* decision.
rules: No fixed checklist is required to save, review or continue research.
Omitted gates are NOT_REVIEWED, never silently SATISFIED.
REQUIRED is optional planning advice and does not force another Task.
Lean/formalization is deferred, not an ordinary research or acceptance prerequisite.

tasks.task_role: Optional nonblank descriptive purpose, default RESEARCH; not an execution role grant.
tasks.native_task_admission: Task schema, successor gate, objective binding and publication preflight remain mandatory.

decision_conditions.RESULT_ACCEPTED_TASK_OPEN_CONTINUATION: Accepted scientific result with an incomplete Task. Requires ACCEPTED/NONE, unchanged raw/view NO_GO and RESULT_ONLY or CANDIDATE_NOT_TOOL, current Task publication and current own publishing session/DA. Pins selected immutable scientific report and complete interface content in the current verified Source snapshot; historical Source commit is a provenance locator, not runtime-reverified tree membership. Preserves process UNKNOWN with exact obligations, no new tasks; grants no Task/parent completion, claim, execution or dependency release. A current authorized successor publisher may consume the original scientific scope without replacing its author.
decision_conditions.TASK_SET_PUBLISHED: One or more substantive tasks; preserve Result successor restrictions and parent Objective.
decision_conditions.PARENT_OBJECTIVE_CLOSURE: No new tasks; parent Objective must already be canonically CLOSED.
decision_conditions.TASK_SCOPE_CLOSURE_PORTFOLIO_CONTINUATIO: No new tasks; accepted PASS/SUCCESS Task with SATISFIED hard target or the native pinned explicit Driver satisfaction assessment. Requires terminal_scope=TASK and portfolio_continuation; grants no parent completion.
decision_conditions.EXISTING_CONTROL_ASSET_BOUND: No new tasks. Bind exactly the existing integration publication named by an ACCEPTED/FOLLOWUP_TASK exact-set synthesis. Require the current source Task publication, own active Driver session/DA, and current operational destination; any later destination generation requires explicit current_destination_continuation. Preserve historical authors and grant no Task or parent closure.
decision_conditions.EXISTING_PUBLISHED_TASK_BOUND: No new tasks or reviews. Bind the exact already-published Driver Task named by one operational ACCEPTED/FOLLOWUP_TASK immutable review, with own current Driver session/DA. Preserve its lineage, publisher, owner and completion state. Use explicit supersedes_followup_packet_id to correct an existing packet while retaining its original bytes. Supplies current source evidence; grants no new CLAIM, Task/parent completion or theorem acceptance.

rules: Only valid for EXISTING_CONTROL_ASSET_BOUND or EXISTING_PUBLISHED_TASK_BOUND; tasks must be empty.

EXISTING_CONTROL_ASSET_BOUND retains the exact-set synthesis and original INTEGRATION lineage requirements. EXISTING_PUBLISHED_TASK_BOUND consumes one accepted immutable review and retains the already-published Task lineage without retyping it.
Both paths require the exact Driver-published destination in the same parent Objective and current own Driver session/DA.

rules: The native writer pins previous record bytes and requires one connected source-preserving correction chain with one current head.
